<section class="v-section v-method" id="method" aria-labelledby="method-title">
  <header class="v-section-heading"><h2 id="method-title">Anatomy, modeled in three dimensions</h2><p>Native 3D tokens. Global context. Spatial control.</p></header>
  <div class="v-method-layout">
    <figure class="v-framework"><a class="v-figure-link" href="../../assets/paper-figures/voldit-figure-1-framework.jpg" aria-label="View full VolDiT framework figure"><img src="../../assets/paper-figures/voldit-figure-1-framework.jpg" width="1472" height="879" loading="lazy" alt="VolDiT framework: a volumetric autoencoder compresses a CT scan, a 3D diffusion transformer denoises latent patches, and a timestep-gated control adapter adds segmentation-mask guidance."><i class="bi bi-arrows-fullscreen" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><figcaption><span>VolDiT framework · Figure 1</span><a href="../../assets/paper-figures/voldit-figure-1-framework.jpg">View full figure <i class="bi bi-arrow-up-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></figcaption></figure>
    <ol class="v-method-steps">
      <li><span class="v-step-number" aria-hidden="true">01</span><h3>Compress the volume</h3><p>A volumetric autoencoder maps a CT scan into a compact 3D latent space.</p></li>
      <li><span class="v-step-number" aria-hidden="true">02</span><h3>Learn global structure</h3><p>A diffusion transformer models spatial relationships across native 3D tokens.</p></li>
      <li><span class="v-step-number" aria-hidden="true">03</span><h3>Guide the anatomy</h3><p>A timestep-gated adapter adds segmentation guidance to a frozen backbone.</p></li>
    </ol>
  </div>
  <p class="v-method-summary">VolDiT combines compact volumetric representation with global self-attention. The same backbone supports unconditional generation and synthesis guided by segmentation masks.</p>
  <a class="v-next" href="#results">See the evidence <i class="bi bi-arrow-down" aria-hidden="true"></i></a>
</section>

<section class="v-section v-results" id="results" aria-labelledby="results-title">
  <header class="v-section-heading"><h2 id="results-title">Generation quality, measured</h2><p>Results from the MICCAI 2026 paper · 100 generated volumes per comparison.</p></header>
  <div class="v-results-body">
    <div class="v-tables">
      <div class="v-table-scroll" role="region" aria-label="LUNA16 generation results" tabindex="0"><table><caption><strong>LUNA16</strong><span>3D MedicalNet features</span></caption><thead><tr><th scope="col">Model</th><th scope="col">FID ↓</th><th scope="col">Precision ↑</th><th scope="col">Recall ↑</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><th scope="row">U-Net LDM</th><td>0.031</td><td>0.44</td><td>0.94</td></tr><tr><th scope="row">HA-GAN</th><td>0.126</td><td>1.00</td><td>0.00</td></tr><tr class="v-result-highlight"><th scope="row">VolDiT (L, p=4)</th><td><strong>0.004</strong></td><td>0.91</td><td>0.90</td></tr></tbody></table></div>
      <div class="v-table-scroll" role="region" aria-label="TaviCT generation results" tabindex="0"><table><caption><strong>TaviCT</strong><span>2.5D ImageNet features</span></caption><thead><tr><th scope="col">Model</th><th scope="col">FID ↓</th><th scope="col">Precision ↑</th><th scope="col">Recall ↑</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><th scope="row">U-Net LDM</th><td>36.8</td><td>0.95</td><td>0.63</td></tr><tr><th scope="row">HA-GAN</th><td>155.5</td><td>1.00</td><td>0.00</td></tr><tr class="v-result-highlight"><th scope="row">VolDiT (L, p=2)</th><td><strong>21.4</strong></td><td>0.94</td><td>0.73</td></tr></tbody></table></div>
    </div>
    <p class="v-caption v-fid-note">FID uses different feature extractors; compare values only within each dataset.</p>
    <div class="v-control-results"><h3>Spatial control from segmentation masks</h3><p>Median Dice on TaviCT · Learned timestep gate</p><div class="v-dice-groups">
      <div class="v-dice-group"><h4>Heart</h4><dl><div><dt>VolDiT</dt><dd>0.94</dd></div><div><dt>U-Net</dt><dd>0.89</dd></div></dl></div>
      <div class="v-dice-group"><h4>Aorta</h4><dl><div><dt>VolDiT</dt><dd>0.92</dd></div><div><dt>U-Net</dt><dd>0.83</dd></div></dl></div>
    </div></div>
    <div class="v-results-scope"><p class="v-caption">Fixed-size volumes and dataset-specific autoencoders. Synthetic examples illustrate generation, not clinical validity.</p><a href="https://arxiv.org/html/2603.25181v1">Full results and ablations <i class="bi bi-arrow-up-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></div>
